add.title: ❓ The 9 real questions
add.text:
Out of 85 items "waiting on you", these are the only real questions, each asked once:

1. [Fold LivePage into Page? A yes also answers the Page.class.js trim (items 6 and 32, one decision).](/live/plan/fold/)
2. [One prompt refiner, on Sonnet, in ext/Refine: yes or changes? (item 1)](/live/plan/one-refiner/)
3. [The mentions plan (three steps, about $9): yes or changes? (item 3)](/live/plan/mentions/)
4. [One item tool with three verbs (get, set, call), in eight merges: yes or changes? (item 4)](/live/plan/item-tool/)
5. [Adding an item another list already owns: link it as a Ref instead of moving it? (item 15)](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/chat-model/)
6. [Run the crash-dump command as admin once, about 2 minutes? (item 18)](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-resources/servex-turn-on-windows-crash-dumps-for-n/)
7. [Authorize the Gmail connector in your claude.ai connector settings? (item 58)](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/09/28/cards/authorize-the-gmail-connector/)
8. [Keep the 11-06 twins fold, or undo it (dry run first)? (was missing from the list)](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/)
9. [Switch SERVEX_OPEN_ITEMS on, so what stays open at a close is filed as a task? (was missing from the list)](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/)

Everything else below is a copy of one of these, or an old wait whose work landed or whose agent ended.

tip.text: **Of all 85 items "waiting on you", only 8 are real questions** (9 once duplicates are merged and two missing ones are added; the card at the top lists them). why.title: 🔧 Why the list is so long (the system fixes)
why.text:
Eight ways the "waiting on you" list goes wrong:

1. **A plan handed down waits twice:** once on the agent that wrote it, once on the agent that handed it down (items 1 and 2, 4 and 5, 6 and 16).
2. **An agent's whole session shows as waiting** whenever one of its tasks waits (items 16, 17, 19, 20, 33).
3. **One task is listed twice:** at its own folder and again at its parent's (items 9–11 repeat 12–14).
4. **A daily check-in re-posts a wait as a new question card** each day, so one waiting voice call shows up four times (items 21–24 and 26–29).
5. **A wait never ends when its agent does:** budget pauses and cost gates from 10-03 to 10-17 (items 35–42 and 44–51), voice calls that ended on 11-03 (28, 29), merges that landed 17 days ago (7, 8).
6. **Any card left with an open reply box counts as a question,** even a mic check or a test card (items 43, 54, 62–70), and a decision stays open after its work was built (items 55, 56, 73, 74).
7. **Old proposals were never moved:** before 10-24 each ask in a prompt was filed as a proposal waiting for your approve; new ones are filed open, but the old ones still wait (items 77–85).
8. **The opposite way: some real questions are missing.** A wait written inside a new task's first line is stored as plain data and never starts, so two real questions (the twins fold and the SERVEX_OPEN_ITEMS switch) were not on the list until 11-09.

The fix belongs in the code, not in closing items by hand: count a wait once, at the task that holds it; drop it when its agent has ended; count a card only when it asks something; and make a wait in a task's first line really wait. Logged: [improvements](/framework/ai/improvements.jsonl).
